name: justlakshmi-monorepo
description: JustLakshmi - Plan. Track. Thrive. Monorepo workspace.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/shared && npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/api && npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/shared && npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/shared && npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:api: npm run build --workspace=@justlakshmi/shared && npm run test --workspace=@justlakshmi/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
